paging: All selections optional. Empty means all eligible. Frozen cursor restores original filter; changed selection with cursor is rejected. Full model records stay whole; oversized indivisible record is an explicit error. Physical Object Attribute groups may continue only at the last group, using incomplete_object_key and matching selected_attribute_names. No raw-JSON fragments, silent truncation, hidden context append, live DB or SQL tools.
null_semantics: [] known empty; null input section unavailable. Unavailable reader errors rather than returning [] and implying absence.
